summary: Independent validation of NEW Free World avatar/timer behavior + regression check that /login flash is gone after early-unlock confirm. ALL primary acceptance criteria pass on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). Player1 shows exactly one waiting-state avatar between L1 and L2 that survives 3 refreshes; exactly one countdown timer on L2 (Level 3+ locked but no timer); early-unlock hint only on L2; L3/L4 hints absent. Confirmed early-unlock flow: modal opens, confirm charges 1 token (350->349), sonner toast (implicit via balance chip update), avatar transitions to 'at-level' on L2, timers=0, PLAY affordance appears, L3 still has no timer/hint (progression not advanced), AND the app stays on /world (NO /login flash any time during the 4s post-confirm observation window â€” iteration_35 MEDIUM bug is FIXED). Player_broke shows 'Not enough tokens', no confirm button, and Top Up navigates to /my-account/wallet. Guest /world access still works and shows L1. Leaderboard button opens Champion Leaderboard. No mojibake detected. Mobile viewport preserves waiting avatar visible + 1 timer + bottom nav visible.

issues: Header logo 'PRIZE LEAGUE' visually overlaps the Â£257,500 pot text at 390px width â€” text-on-text overlap, low readability. Center pot chip should stack or shrink below ~430px.

Level 2 label + 'TAP TO EARLY UNLOCK' pill + 'UNLOCKS IN 1d ...' timer + 'WAITING' badge + 'FIRST STOP' badge are all rendered in a tight vertical stack right beside L2 and the WAITING avatar; the 'WAITING' badge sits directly on top of the avatar sprite. Functional but crowded â€” consider hiding FIRST-STOP marker or repositioning WAITING label above the avatar on mobile.

The .pl2d-bottom-token HOME button reports getBoundingClientRect() of {0,0,0,0} to Playwright even though the button is visually rendered (screenshots confirm). JS-based click works and correctly stays on /world with progress preserved. Likely the button element has zero intrinsic size (flex child) while its children render outside the box, or is rendered inside a wrapper with display contents. Fixing this improves testability/a11y; users are unaffected.

action_items: MINOR: Fix mobile header overlap between PRIZE LEAGUE logo and Â£257,500 pot chip at <=430px width.
MINOR: On mobile, reposition/collapse WAITING badge + FIRST STOP marker so they don't overlap the avatar sprite next to L2.

MINOR (testability): Give the HOME/PAID CONTESTS/LEADERBOARD bottom-nav buttons non-zero bounding boxes and stable data-testids (e.g. pl2d-nav-home, pl2d-nav-paid, pl2d-nav-leaderboard) so Playwright can interact without JS-eval fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: WorldCanvas.jsx is 2896 lines â€” split into ChampionshipSection, EarlyUnlockModal, BottomNav, and progressAvatar helpers to reduce cognitive load and re-render cost.

goToFreeContests() calls navigateTo('/world') when already on /world â€” this is a no-op React Router navigation, so the HOME button does not actually recenter the map. If 'recenter viewport on current progression' is a spec requirement, the handler should also imperatively scroll the map container to the avatar's element (as a scroll effect) rather than only route-navigating.
Bottom-nav buttons should carry data-testid attributes matching the spec (pl2d-nav-home etc.) â€” currently only class-based selection works.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on core acceptance criteria (avatar always visible, waiting state, single timer, early-unlock scope, unlock success without /login flash, progression not advanced, insufficient-balance, guest access, leaderboard, mobile, retry-modal wiring present); 3 minor design/testability observations
